content: A call of Dem_SetDTCFilter sets the requested filter on the event memory assigned to ClientID of the call.
A call of Dem_SetDTCFilter sets the requested filter on the event memory assigned to ClientID of the call.

A call of a DTC filter setting API • Dem_SetDTCFilter • Dem_SetDTCFilterByExtendedDataRecordNumber • Dem_SetDTCFilterByReadinessGroup shall set the requested filter on the event memory set assigned to ClientID of the call.
